accentShapeRule: Exact matched base contours are shortened; top marks follow the shortened top rigidly plus gap; below marks follow the lower edge; side marks retain placement. followBase links shortening to the plain capital. Whole-composite lowering is separate.
spacingImplementation: SVG fixed-advance ink-shift simulation; not OpenType GSUB or GPOS shaping
morph: Vertical top/tail-height remapping plus y junction raise (0..150, original-coordinate plateau -20..110; tapered to zero at -120/400). Separate segment-masked horizontal controls: Q/y/j terminal translation and connector truncation in font units; g descender compression in percent. Bodies and advances are not horizontally scaled. Approximate Bezier control-point morph, not optical redraw. Mapped accented-capital bodies can be shortened independently or follow their plain base; accents translate rigidly with their base edge and top gap. Optional above-accent capitals also receive rigid whole-composite lowering. Open double-storey g is a custom Monofuki-derived alternate. Contextual spacing shifts ink only and is not font shaping. The 7 crossbar is a separate rounded shape in final font coordinates; positive angle rises to the right, length is end-to-end, thickness is perpendicular, and x/y locate its center independently of digit shortening.
